# Check current behavior for key scenarios
import arrow
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

eastern = dateutil_tz.gettz("US/Eastern")

# m1 scenario
arw = arrow.Arrow.fromdatetime(datetime(2023, 2, 12, 2, 30), tzinfo=eastern)
print(f"DST imaginary date: {arw}, imaginary={arw.imaginary}")

# Try shift without check_imaginary (should work currently)
try:
    result_default = arw.shift(months=1)
    print(f"shift(months=1) default: {result_default}, hour={result_default.hour}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"shift(months=1) error: {e}")

# m2 scenarios
print("\nm2 scenarios:")
a1 = arrow.get(2023, 1, 1)
a2 = arrow.get(2023, 2, 1)
a3 = arrow.get(2023, 3, 1)
print(f"Jan 1 -> Feb 1: {a1.humanize(a2)}")
print(f"Jan 1 -> Mar 1: {a1.humanize(a3)}")

# DST boundary
d1 = arrow.Arrow.fromdatetime(datetime(2023, 2, 12, 2, 30), tzinfo=eastern)
d2 = arrow.Arrow.fromdatetime(datetime(2023, 3, 12, 2, 30), tzinfo=eastern)
print(f"DST boundary humanize: {d1.humanize(d2)}")
print(f"d1={d1}, d2={d2}")
